3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The Porte Drazon Observatory Tower stood tall against the night sky, stars twinkling overhead, as my motorcade arrived beneath it.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Before long, Titus and I vacated our vehicle, entered the building and ascended the spiraling staircase.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: The celestial event held the prospect of a connection to the divine, a moment I had been eagerly anticipating.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: We eventually reached the top. I was nearly out of breath, whereas Titus seemed to breeze through it without breaking a sweat.
10.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true) == false)

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: By the time I was halfway up, I was beginning to regret that an elevator hadn't been installed.

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: Titus, on the other hand, barely broke a sweat.

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "I really need to get on whatever workout regimen you're on."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "At least pretend like you're not struggling to climb so many stairs."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "Slow down, will you? You're making me look bad."

20.speaker: Titus Gordion
20.text: "It would be my honor. Just let me know when, and I'll make it happen."

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: Titus smiled -- the closest I think I've ever seen him to laughing.

22.speaker: Titus Gordion
22.text: "I call it my 'graceful ascent' technique. It's a Golden Guard secret."

23.speaker: Titus Gordion
23.text: "My apologies. I'll adjust my stride to align more with your esteemed pace."

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: Two guards greeted us at a door, one of whom opened it. I stepped inside while Titus remained behind.

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: The dimly lit room carried the scent of aged books and burning incense, while candles cast a soft glow.

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: Sal was hunched over an altar adorned with astrological charts and religious artifacts, seemingly unaware of my presence.

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "I have been looking forward to this visit."
27.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true) == false)

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "Sal, my trusted spiritual advisor, I've been looking forward to this visit."
28.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true) == false)

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "I see my arrival has gone unnoticed amidst your celestial preparations."
29.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true) == false)

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "Most people know to stand when their king enters the room."
30.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true) == false)

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true) == false)

41.speaker: Player_Romus
41.text: "I guess God didn't alert you to my entrance."
41.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true) == false)

42.speaker: Sal Ignacius
42.text: "Forgive my oversight, Your Majesty. I didn't realize you had entered."

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: He looked up as if startled.

44.speaker: Sal Ignacius
44.text: "It's remarkable that we're about to witness the same celestial alignment St. Wruhec beheld so many years ago."

45.speaker: Sal Ignacius
45.text: "The cosmos has a language of its own. Tonight, it speaks of destiny and the intertwining of fates."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "One I look forward to hearing for myself. Speaking of which, how do the people of Rizia interpret the cosmic language?"

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "Well, I didn't bring my 'Interstellar Linguist' with me, so you'll have to do the translating for me."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "And I do hope its message illuminates our religious journey. Speaking of which, how do the people of Rizia interpret the cosmic language?"

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: “As the one guiding Rizia’s destiny, I speak its language fluently.”

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "Until then, let's pass the time by speaking about the state of religious affairs in Rizia."

58.speaker: Sal Ignacius
58.text: "And I am here to assist you in its translation."

59.speaker: Sal Ignacius
59.text: "Certainly. I'd be delighted to provide you with an overview."

60.speaker: Sal Ignacius
60.text: "It holds a unique place in their hearts and is as diverse as the stars above. As for their overall prevailing sentiments..."

61.speaker: Sal Ignacius
61.text: "It occupies a distinctive corner in their hearts, as diverse as the stars that grace the night sky. As for their overall prevailing sentiments..."

62.speaker: Sal Ignacius
62.text: "I hope to do more than just translate, but decipher the cosmic narrative, as embodied by your loyal subjects below."

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: Sal's eyes lit up, illuminated by faint moonlight.

64.speaker: Sal Ignacius
64.text: "It is a message of gratitude, Your Majesty. The Wruhecists of Rizia overwhelmingly favor your reign."

68.speaker: Sal Ignacius
68.text: "They -- and I -- certainly appreciated your efforts to restore the Archsanctuary of Plavo."

72.speaker: Sal Ignacius
72.text: "I'm happy to say that you command a high level of respect among their congregations."

73.speaker: Sal Ignacius
73.text: "Expanding the Grandsanctuary of Sallabes has greatly boosted Your Majesty's popularity in the community."

77.speaker: Sal Ignacius
77.text: "They view it as both a physical and symbolic preservation of their religious heritage."

81.speaker: Sal Ignacius
81.text: "It goes without saying that the blasphemy law continues to strain relations."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "The idea of Rizians and Palesians taking arms against each other is deeply unsettling. Does Wruhecism justify such conflict?"

86.speaker: Sal Ignacius
86.text: "Your Majesty, the teachings of Wruhism advocate for peace, unity, and the pursuit of harmony."

87.speaker: Sal Ignacius
87.text: "War goes against these principles, giving rise to both suffering and discord."

88.speaker: Sal Ignacius
88.text: "However, in the sacred texts, we find instances where war was deemed just, a means to protect the divine order."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Does Wruhecism condemn taking back what's rightfully ours by force? Or is it merely a convenient shroud for the weak?"

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "As Wruhecists, we are committed to peace. But what if violence is needed to maintain that peace?"

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "And how do we know if going to war with Pales aligns with the sacred text?"
94.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DeclareWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_PrepareForWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == true)

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "Justified? That wasn't what I was expecting to hear. Please continue."

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "So, in the cosmic manual, there's a chapter on 'Justifiable Warfare.' Good bedtime reading, I'm sure."
102.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DeclareWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_PrepareForWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == true)

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "And how do we know if going to war with Pales aligns with the divine order?"
103.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_DeclareWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_PrepareForWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.PostIncident_Border_JointInvestigation"] == true)

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "Peace is for those content with mediocrity. A king must be strong, commanding, willing to seize what's rightfully his. What use is a faith that shackles ambition?"

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "I respect the pursuit of peace, but I'm curious about how strength and ambition can coexist within our faith."

109.speaker: Sal Ignacius
109.text: "The scriptures speak of just wars, wars waged in defense of the divine message or to protect the pillars of enlightenment."

110.speaker: Sal Ignacius
110.text: "Yet, we must scrutinize our motives. Is our cause just, or are we swayed by ambition?"

111.speaker: Sal Ignacius
111.text: "War should be the last resort, employed only when all avenues for peace have been exhausted."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "We need to ensure that our motives for war are not rooted in personal benefits and for the greater good."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "Yet, relying solely on war as the final option might lead to overlooked opportunities or even outright defeat."

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "So, what you're saying is, we should exhaust all options until we're all too tired to fight? Great strategy."

121.speaker: Player_Romus
121.text: "Then we must ensure that our war is righteous and serves not personal gain but the divine order."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "I will not be constrained by the whims of God. If war is the path to power, then Wruhecism can be bent to serve it."

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "I value divine guidance, but my priority is the well-being of my people. Therefore, I'll align our faith with the path that ensures our realm's prosperity."

127.speaker: Sal Ignacius
127.text: "Precisely. If war becomes unavoidable, it must be waged with a heavy heart, a heart burdened by the weight of righteousness."

128.speaker: Sal Ignacius
128.text: "We must be vigilant, for the divine does not condone unjust actions, even in the face of conflict."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "I believe this war is justified. In defending ourselves, we preserve our cherished values and traditions."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "Then, I'll need to ensure that my next move in this conflict aligns with the principles of Wruhecism, as provided by our sacred text, to justify it."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "Noted. I'll be sure to send a prayer for justice before my next strategic move."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "I believe God would deem this war justified. In defending ourselves, we preserve our cherished values and traditions."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "Our actions are just if the Crown says they are. Religious dogma is a tool to be wielded, not the other way around."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "With all due respect, religious dogma is a guiding tool, not a master."

144.speaker: Sal Ignacius
144.text: "May the Divine guide our actions in accordance with the sacred teachings."

148.speaker: Sal Ignacius
148.text: "There's nothing weak about adhering to one's religious values."

149.speaker: Sal Ignacius
149.text: "And it is most certainly not a shroud, It's a call to uphold the divine order."

150.speaker: Sal Ignacius
150.text: "War contradicts these principles, causing suffering and discord. Wruhecism stresses the importance of peace and the quest for harmony."

151.speaker: Sal Ignacius
151.text: "Wruhecism doesn't shackle ambition; it guides it toward righteousness."

152.speaker: Sal Ignacius
152.text: "The pursuit of power at the cost of others is not what the divine order advocates."

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "What if the divine order aligns with expansion, conquest?"

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "Yes, however, the path of governance may require decisions that, while distasteful, align with the greater divine purpose."

155.speaker: Sal Ignacius
155.text: "It firmly opposes any form of subjugation."

156.speaker: Sal Ignacius
156.text: "The divine order calls for compassion, wisdom, and humility. War, especially unjust war, is not the path to righteousness."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "Righteousness doesn't fill coffers or expand borders. The divine order, if it exists, must understand the necessity of sacrifice for the greater good."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "While I respect those virtues, the path to righteousness might sometimes involve a sterner resolve, a divine duty to protect what is sacred."

160.speaker: Sal Ignacius
160.text: "Sacrifice for the greater good should ensure that our pursuits are just and honorable."

161.speaker: Sal Ignacius
161.text: "War is a path to destruction, and a kingdom built on such foundations will crumble."

165.speaker: Sal Ignacius
165.text: "The principles of Wruhecism promote peace, unity, and the pursuit of harmony."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Come now, Sal, surely there's a divine loophole for a good, hearty war."

167.speaker: Sal Ignacius
167.text: "War conflicts with these principles, giving rise to both suffering and discord."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "But does it really? It seems our history is littered with war and violence."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "War might be serious business, but imagine if we could solve conflicts with sarcastic banter."

170.speaker: Sal Ignacius
170.text: "There are instances in the sacred texts where war is justified, but it's not a divine loophole for merriment."

171.speaker: Sal Ignacius
171.text: "The circumstances must align with celestial principles."

172.speaker: Player_Romus
172.text: "To be perfectly honest, I fear that keeping Rizia under one religious banner might lead to further divisions and unrest within our borders."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "Wruhecisim, Dastnurism, Golcondism... it’s all the same to me. It's maintaining order and preserving the monarchy that's most important."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "Wruhecisim, Dastnurism, Golcondism -- it's like trying to distinguish between different shades of beige. I prioritize order and preserving the monarchy's characteristic blandness."

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "I believe in the importance of upholding the one truth faith. However, I fear it might lead to further divisions within our borders."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "All opposition against me must end. Period. If religion can help us to achieve unity, I will wholeheartedly welcome it."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "It’s unity I seek above all else. And if religion, in any manifestation, can achieve that, I will wholeheartedly welcome it."

187.speaker: Sal Ignacius
187.text: "It goes without saying that I'm partial to Rizia as a Wruhescist state, but I will concede that there is more than one approach that could be considered."

188.speaker: Sal Ignacius
188.text: "Well, Your Majesty, if that's how you see it, then I suppose the nuances of the Nurist faith might indeed elude your discerning eye."

189.speaker: Sal Ignacius
189.text: "Are you speaking to me as your counselor on religion, or would you like to know what I really think?"

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "I aim to understand all available choices thoroughly to ensure that my decision is well-informed."

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "I want you to speak as a man of faith."

192.speaker: Player_Romus
192.text: "Don't play coy. Just tell me what you think."

195.speaker: Sal Ignacius
195.text: "That said, as your counselor on religious affairs, I'm more than happy to share my unbiased thoughts."

197.speaker: Sal Ignacius
197.text: "Alternatively, we could embrace a pluralist faith-based state, recognizing the diversity of beliefs in our realm.”

198.speaker: Sal Ignacius
198.text: "Lastly -- I can't believe I'm saying this -- you could separate religion from government entirely, taking a secular approach that would allow each citizen the freedom to navigate their faith independently."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "What do you personally believe we should do?"

200.speaker: Sal Ignacius
200.text: "Come now, Your Majesty, as a devout follower of Wruhecism, it's only natural that I'd stand firm for it in our kingdom."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "What are the pros and cons of remaining a Wruhecist state?"

202.speaker: Sal Ignacius
202.text: "All of which, bear in mind, come with specific drawbacks and advantages."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "Tell me what a governance that accommodates Nurity as a whole would look like."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "As difficult as it may be, can you paint a picture of what a secular state might look like?"

206.speaker: Sal Ignacius
206.text: "Personal feelings aside, the key element of taking a pluralistic approach lies in establishing a framework that respects diversity while maintaining a common ground for governance."

207.speaker: Sal Ignacius
207.text: “Unlike a singular religious influence which may exclude some and foster resentment and alienation among non-adherents."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: "True, but I can also see us gambling with the stability of our kingdom by attempting to please everyone."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "Yes, I understand the benefits of pluralism, but it could also undermine a unified belief system, causing confusion and division."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "I could get behind that. Every citizen should feel a part of our shared journey."

212.speaker: Sal Ignacius
212.text: "A pluralist approach has its advantages, but a kingdom united under one religion might ensure greater stability within the realm."

215.speaker: Sal Ignacius
215.text: "The stability that Wruhecism brings to our kingdom is unmatched. It serves as a unifying force, and provides a strong foundation for governance."

216.speaker: Sal Ignacius
216.text: "By maintaining it as the state religion, we can preserve the harmony we've enjoyed and potentially extend its influence throughout the realm--"

217.speaker: Sal Ignacius
217.text: "Overall, it would foster a more cohesive and culturally unified society."

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "I see the potential for cultural unity. However, are we not risking exclusion and potential unrest from those whose beliefs don't align with Wruhecism?"

220.speaker: Sal Ignacius
220.text: "While I appreciate the sentiment, I find it challenging to fully embrace a pluralistic approach."

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "Are we not risking stifling diversity and limiting the freedom of our citizens to choose their own faith?"

222.speaker: Player_Romus
222.text: "What about the potential for resistance and opposition from those who don't adhere to Wruhecism?"

223.speaker: Sal Ignacius
223.text: "There's a risk of limiting individual freedom, I won't deny that. But by emphasizing Wruhecism doesn't mean we're eradicating diversity."

224.speaker: Sal Ignacius
224.text: "Resistance is a possibility, but with strategic communication and a gradual implementation of policies, we can minimize opposition."

225.speaker: Sal Ignacius
225.text: "A united kingdom under one religious banner provides a clear direction."

226.speaker: Sal Ignacius
226.text: "It might involve some *adjustment* for those who follow different paths, but the benefits of a cohesive identity would outweigh the initial challenges."

227.speaker: Sal Ignacius
227.text: "Citizens can still practice their faith privately; we're merely establishing a common ground for governance."

228.speaker: Sal Ignacius
228.text: "The goal is to emphasize the benefits of unity while respecting individual beliefs within the private sphere."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "Unifying the entire kingdom under the banner of Wruhecism... I must say, I find the idea appealing."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "It sounds good in theory. But I have my doubts about how it will work out in practice."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "You're just saying that because if I removed Wruhecism as the state religion, you'd be out of a job."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "I can't help but think your views on this are biased, Sal."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "I don't know... Keeping religion out of government entirely may be wiser. We don't want Rizia to become another theocratic state like Derdia."

251.speaker: Sal Ignacius
251.text: "In a secular state, the governance would operate independently of religious influence."

252.speaker: Sal Ignacius
252.text: "Policies and decisions would be based on law -- absent of the influence of a specific religious doctrine."

253.speaker: Sal Ignacius
253.text: "It would potentially promote inclusivity by ensuring equal treatment for citizens of all faiths and those with none."

254.speaker: Player_Romus
254.text: "But doesn't it risk losing the moral compass that religion often provides in governance?"

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "Thank you. Now tell me what you really think."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "What are the drawbacks to taking such an approach?"

257.speaker: Sal Ignacius
257.text: "Your Majesty, while equal treatment is commendable, it may lead to the loss of divine guidance in decision-making."

258.speaker: Sal Ignacius
258.text: "Yes, however, to entertain a counterpoint, some would argue that it allows for a moral framework that is not exclusive to a particular faith."

259.speaker: Sal Ignacius
259.text: "It's my belief that embracing a secular state risks diluting the cultural and moral fabric that Wruhecism has woven into our kingdom."

260.speaker: Sal Ignacius
260.text: "Without religious principles, the government may lack a moral compass, prone to wandering aimlessly."

261.speaker: Sal Ignacius
261.text: "Straying from this path risks dishonoring our heritage and the sacrifices our forefathers fought to uphold."

262.speaker: Sal Ignacius
262.text: "It's not just a religion; it's a reflection of our identity, a link to our past."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "I value our kingdom's history but prioritize progress and citizen rights. A secular government may provide the needed solution."

264.speaker: Sal Ignacius
264.text: "One where citizens, irrespective of their religious affiliations, can coexist under a common set of ethical standards."

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "You've actually made a great case for secularism. Grand Wiseman. To me, the benefits outweigh the drawbacks."

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "Yes, religion obviously belongs in our kingdom's government. I was just curious what you'd say."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "Thank you for indulging me on this, even if it clearly isn't your own cup of tea."

268.speaker: Sal Ignacius
268.text: "Can secularism match the same level of commitment to high moral standards?"

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "I like what I'm hearing so far. So what's the fine print -- the 'terms and conditions' of this grand idea?"

273.speaker: Sal Ignacius
273.text: "Additionally, straying from this path risks dishonoring our Wruhecist heritage and the sacrifices our forefathers fought to uphold."

274.speaker: Sal Ignacius
274.text: "I'm glad you asked. While equal treatment is commendable, it may lead to the loss of divine guidance in decision-making."

276.speaker: Sal Ignacius
276.text: "However, such an approach also comes with great risks."

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "I already told you I didn't want to hear your personal views on the matter."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "Risks are but shadows that fade in the radiance of our faith. However, please share your concerns."

280.speaker: Sal Ignacius
280.text: "Of course. Forgive me. This subject holds significant importance for me."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "Ah, risks -- the unsung heroes of decision-making. Let's hear them."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "Risks are inherent in any course of action. However, let's hear your concerns."

297.speaker: Sal Ignacius
297.text: "One significant worry I harbor is the push for equal treatment of all religions in governance."

298.speaker: Sal Ignacius
298.text: "One of my foremost concerns is the proposition of equal treatment for all religions in governance. This could jeopardize the sacred and distinct guidance we receive from Wruhecism in our decision-making processes."

302.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
302.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_ReligiousBriefing_DiscussSingleReligiousGov"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_ReligiousBriefing_DiscussSecularReligiousGov"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_ReligiousBriefing_DiscussPluralistReligiousGov"] == true) == false

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "I wish for Rizia to remain Wruhecist. And if you believe the Sanctuary should play a larger role in government, I am open to that discussion."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "As I see it, the best way forward to fostering unity may involve embracing not just Wruhecism, but Dastnurity as well."

305.speaker: Player_Romus
305.text: "I'm leaning toward avoiding governmental interference in matters of faith by adopting a secular approach."

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "Choosing a secular path would liberate our kingdom from religious influence, fostering true communal enlightenment."

307.speaker: Narrator
307.text: A moment of silence fell between us. Even the night seemed unable to cloak his obvious disapproval.

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "You've given me a lot to think about. It seems the path I choose for Rizia's religious future could shape our kingdom profoundly."
308.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_ReligiousBriefing_DiscussSingleReligiousGov"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_ReligiousBriefing_DiscussSecularReligiousGov"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_ReligiousBriefing_DiscussPluralistReligiousGov"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateSal"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religion_SalReligiousOpinion"] == false) == false)

309.speaker: Player_Romus
309.text: "I see the value in adapting to the changing times, but that brings its own set of problems."

310.speaker: Player_Romus
310.text: "Maintaining fidelity to Wruhecism is crucial, yet I'm cautious of the repercussions should we persist without change."

311.speaker: Player_Romus
311.text: "Maintaining unity within our kingdom is paramount."

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "This is why removing religious influence from government may be the best choice, though it could provoke significant backlash."

313.speaker: Sal Ignacius
313.text: "Venturing from the status quo is akin to navigating through dense fog."

314.speaker: Sal Ignacius
314.text: "A noble pursuit. Keeping in mind that it is our shared Wruhecist values that unite us all."

315.speaker: Sal Ignacius
315.text: "'Backlash' would be an understatement. It could spark dissent and upheaval throughout the kingdom."

316.speaker: Sal Ignacius
316.text: "I too share your concerns. However, I would encourage you not to take a course of action that undermines the core principles of the one true faith."

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: I continued looking out over the city as Sal's counsel resonated in my mind.

318.speaker: Narrator
318.text: I knew that any decision I made regarding Rizia's religious future carried the risk of backlash -- if I decided to make any changes at all.

319.speaker: Narrator
319.text: As the question consumed my thoughts, the heavens seemed to respond.

320.speaker: Narrator
320.text: Six planets shone above us in a perfect arc, each brighter than the last.

321.speaker: Sal Ignacius
321.text: "My God... it's even more breathtaking than I could have ever imagined."

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: A hush lingered between us briefly. The night, despite its darkness, couldn't obscure his disapproval.

323.speaker: Narrator
323.text: Sal's face shone brighter than the stars above.

324.speaker: Narrator
324.text: An uncomfortable silence settled between us. Even the night seemed powerless to conceal his anger.

325.speaker: Sal Ignacius
325.text: "I respectfully disagree with the notion of a dual-religion approach."

326.speaker: Sal Ignacius
326.text: "A secular approach may lead to a cultural vacuum, devoid of the spiritual principles that have held us together."

327.speaker: Sal Ignacius
327.text: "And you are coming dangerously close to using the language of Malenyevism."

328.speaker: Sal Ignacius
328.text: "Either way, as your counselor, I'll stand by your decision."

330.speaker: Player_Romus
330.text: "Nice view, but let's not overthink it."

331.speaker: Player_Romus
331.text: "At least the stars got their act together. Unlike some courtiers I know who never seem to align their opinions."

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "Inspirational, perhaps, for those with stargazing hearts."

333.speaker: Sal Ignacius
333.text: "Your Majesty, your power is a guiding light that can illuminate the path to righteousness."

334.speaker: Sal Ignacius
334.text: "By issuing decrees and government mandates aligned with Wruhecism's principles, its teachings could permeate throughout the kingdom."
334.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false)

335.speaker: Sal Ignacius
335.text: "It would be an honor for me to accompany you on this journey toward enlightenment."

336.speaker: Player_Romus
336.text: "I appreciate your enthusiasm. But we must proceed with caution to avoid antagonizing religious minorities."

337.speaker: Player_Romus
337.text: "I'm still not 100% certain this is the plan I wish to pursue. But I won't close off the possibility."

338.speaker: Sal Ignacius
338.text: "Excellent, Your Majesty. A wise king never closes his mind to the divine."

339.speaker: Sal Ignacius
339.text: "If this ultimately becomes the Crown's policy it's crucial to have a trusted advisor by your side."

340.speaker: Sal Ignacius
340.text: "Perhaps even going so far as to reassess the role of the Grand Vizier..."

341.speaker: Narrator
341.text: The Grand Wiseman took a step toward me.

342.speaker: Player_Romus
342.text: "Yes, promoting Rizia's Grand Wiseman to a higher governmental role aligns with our vision for a holy kingdom."

343.speaker: Player_Romus
343.text: "I won't get the opportunity to change around the seats on the Royal Council for another few years. Remind me again then."

344.speaker: Player_Romus
344.text: "I would never replace my uncle, Grand Wiseman. Besides, I know him to be a man of faith as well."

345.speaker: Sal Ignacius
345.text: "Replacing your uncle would have to be done with the utmost sensitivity, of course."

346.speaker: Sal Ignacius
346.text: "The opportunity to reshuffle your Royal Council is still several years away."

347.speaker: Narrator
347.text: Sal and I said our goodbyes before we parted ways.

348.speaker: Narrator
348.text: After descending the observation tower and stepping outside with Titus, I was again greeted by the celestial phenomenon above.

349.speaker: Narrator
349.text: Titus momentarily stopped in his tracks to gaze overhead. It was then I realized this was his first time seeing it.

350.speaker: Titus Gordion
350.text: "This is... astonishing. I've never seen anything like it before."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "Such a heavenly display unveils the divine touch, captivating even the most devoted observers."

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "Careful, Titus. Stare at it long enough and you'll go blind."

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: This is no time for childish wonder, Titus. Remember your duty and act accordingly."

363.speaker: Player_Romus
363.text: "With all due respect, please don't let celestial antics distract you, Titus. We have other pressing matters to attend to."

364.speaker: Titus Gordion
364.text: "Of course, Your Majesty. Please forgive me. I just got caught up by the sight of it."

365.speaker: Titus Gordion
365.text: "My apologies, Your Majesty. The extraordinary view momentarily captured my attention."

366.speaker: Titus Gordion
366.text: "I couldn't have said it better myself."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "Yes, one could get lost in its display."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "It's simple science, Titus. Nothing to get worked up over."

369.speaker: Titus Gordion
369.text: "That may be, yet in its beauty, I find glimpses of the divine."

370.speaker: Titus Gordion
370.text: "If blindness is the cost of witnessing such celestial wonders, then consider my eyesight an offering to the cosmos."

371.speaker: Titus Gordion
371.text: "Lost, but in the best possible way."

372.speaker: Narrator
372.text: After savoring the spectacle for a final moment, Titus guided me to my motorcade, and I resumed my journey back to the palace.

375.speaker: Narrator
375.text: Titus quickly assumed a professional manner and escorted me back to the motorcade, where I resumed my journey back to the palace.

376.speaker: Narrator
376.text: Titus promptly adopted a professional demeanor. He guided me to my motorcade, and we resumed our journey back to the palace.

377.speaker: Narrator
377.text: Turning his attention away from the heavens, Titus guided me to my motorcade, and I resumed my journey back to the palace.

378.speaker: Narrator
378.text: Taking a final moment to appreciate the spectacle, Titus directed me to the motorcade, and I proceeded back to the palace.

379.speaker: Narrator
379.text: "After absorbing the spectacle for a final moment, Titus directed me to the waiting motorcade, and I continued my journey back to the palace."

380.speaker: Sal Ignacius
380.text: "Introducing multiple faiths risks diluting the principles that have anchored us for generations."

381.speaker: Sal Ignacius
381.text: "Unity can still be achieved without compromising the strength derived from a singular religious influence."

382.speaker: Sal Ignacius
382.text: "May our actions be guided by the Divine in accordance with the sacred teachings."

384.speaker: Narrator
384.text: However, it now functioned more as a museum than as a site for astronomical observations due to the city's light pollution.

385.speaker: Narrator
385.text: I'd come to meet with Grand Wiseman Ignacius for the Alignment of the Six Stars, a rare celestial event that occurred every 200 years and was celebrated by Wruhecists worldwide.

386.speaker: Narrator
386.text: Despite being irritated by the climb, I concealed my displeasure.
386.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true)

390.speaker: Narrator
390.text: Appearing weak or disgruntled was not an option.

391.speaker: Narrator
391.text: Startled, Sal raised his head to meet my gaze.

392.speaker: Narrator
392.text: His gaze lifted abruptly, a hint of surprise in his eyes.

395.speaker: Player_Romus
395.text: "Take care that you do not ignore me again."

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: "I could reenter if you'd like to try again. Shall I?"

398.speaker: Sal Ignacius
398.text: "No need, Your Majesty. I have no doubt your entrance was magnificent!"

399.speaker: Sal Ignacius
399.text: "But nevermind that. I'm delighted you're here. An exhilarating event awaits you."

401.speaker: Player_Romus
401.text: "I enjoy heavenly displays as much as the next person, but let's not go overboard."

402.speaker: Player_Romus
402.text: "I've heard it before, but a retelling would be welcome."

403.speaker: Sal Ignacius
403.text: "You're right. I'm just brimming with anticipation for tonight's event."

406.speaker: Sal Ignacius
406.text: "Very well then. Let's move on to our main event."

407.speaker: Sal Ignacius
407.text: "If you'll follow me to the balcony, we can continue our discussion while bearing witness to tonight’s event.”

408.speaker: Narrator
408.text: The wiseman's face lit up with a gracious smile.

409.speaker: Sal Ignacius
409.text: "Well, I'm delighted you're here. An exhilarating event awaits you."

410.speaker: Narrator
410.text: Disappointment was evident in the expression on his face.

411.speaker: Sal Ignacius
411.text: "I shall do my best to ensure such oversights don't recur, Your Majesty."

412.speaker: Sal Ignacius
412.text: "Nevertheless, I'm delighted you're here. Prepare yourself for a truly exhilarating evening."

414.speaker: Sal Ignacius
414.text: "I'm delighted to have you here. Tonight’s event promises to be truly exhilarating."

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: Sal cleared his throat and began to pace around the room.

416.speaker: Narrator
416.text: However, when I gazed upward, there were no stars to be seen; nothing but clouds blanketing the sky.

417.speaker: Player_Romus
417.text: "It seems the heavens have other plans in mind."

418.speaker: Player_Romus
418.text: "There are so many other things I could have been doing tonight."

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "Are you sure we'll be able to witness the Alignment tonight?"

420.speaker: Sal Ignacius
420.text: "Cloudy skies may conceal the celestial wonders, but with patience, the beauty may yet be revealed."

421.speaker: Sal Ignacius
421.text: "Have faith. Perhaps the Alignment is just waiting for the right moment."

423.speaker: Narrator
423.text: I stepped into the cool evening air alongside him. Porte Drazon sprawled beneath, its lights flickering like stars in the night.

424.speaker: Sal Ignacius
424.text: "In the tenets of Wruhecism, there unfolds a celestial saga -- the Alignment of the Six Stars."

425.speaker: Sal Ignacius
425.text: "Imagine St. Wruhec, our venerable faith's architect, embarking on a sacred sojourn into the cosmic vastness."

426.speaker: Sal Ignacius
426.text: "Guided by divine insight, St. Wruhec witnessed the cosmic ballet, grasping the profound significance of this alignment."

427.speaker: Sal Ignacius
427.text: "St. Wruhec perceived the alignment as a symbol of spiritual evolution -- a journey toward a more harmonious interconnectedness of the cosmic and goldy realms."

428.speaker: Sal Ignacius
428.text: "Each aligned planet, embodying a pillar, became a torch illuminating simplified teachings and a testament to the diverse perspectives within Wruhecism."

429.speaker: Sal Ignacius
429.text: "The Alignment of the Six Stars acts as a celestial guide, directing the faithful on their journey to enlightenment."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "I must say, you're quite the orator. Your recounting was truly stirring."

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "You had me at 'In the tenets of Wruhecism.' Well done!"

438.speaker: Player_Romus
438.text: "Sorry, I got distracted. Could you repeat that once more?"

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "I've heard the tale a hundred times, but never told so well. Your oratory skills would make St. Wruhec Himself proud."

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "What claptrap. If God told St. Wruhec to throw himself off his observatory tower, he would have done it."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "Nicely done. Though, if I may give a bit of constructive criticism, it could have been shortened."

445.speaker: Sal Ignacius
445.text: "I... the Lord wills only what is best for us, Your Majesty."

446.speaker: Narrator
446.text: A look of frustration crossed the Grand Wiseman's face.

448.speaker: Sal Ignacius
448.text: "And that's what we are here to bear witness to tonight."

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "Ah! That's right. Now I remember. Thanks for the reminder."

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: “I’m only kidding. Well told, Grand Wiseman.”

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "Joking, of course. You couldn't pay me to sit through that story again."

457.speaker: Player_Romus
457.text: "I mean it. Tell the story again."

459.speaker: Player_Romus
459.text: "In light of our impending conflict with Pales, I'd like to understand the religious context and implications of our actions."

460.speaker: Sal Ignacius
460.text: "It pains me to say it, but he says that you've fallen out of favor with the Wruhecist community."

461.speaker: Sal Ignacius
461.text: "I'd be more than happy to illuminate the spiritual facets entwined with our current situation. What would you like to know?"

462.speaker: Player_Romus
462.text: "Does Wruhecism condemn using force to reclaiming what's rightfully ours? I fear pacifism is just a convenient excuse for inaction."

463.speaker: Player_Romus
463.text: "There may come a time when I need to explain our actions to our people from a religious perspective. What does Wruhecism say about it?"

464.speaker: Sal Ignacius
464.text: "Your Majesty, the principles of Wruhecism promote peace, unity, and the pursuit of harmony."

465.speaker: Sal Ignacius
465.text: "I'd argue that pacifism shows incredible strength."

466.speaker: Narrator
466.text: He motioned toward the city below, where celebrations of tonight's event could be heard.

467.speaker: Sal Ignacius
467.text: "They have confided in me that their congregations are not satisfied with your reign."

468.speaker: Sal Ignacius
468.text: "Your refusal to fund the Grandsanctuary expansion they requested in Sallabes has notably diminished Your Majesty’s likability in their community."
468.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_SallabesConsumerIndustry_Completed"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Project"] == true) == false)

469.speaker: Sal Ignacius
469.text: "They perceive it as a symbolic representation of the decline and neglect of their religious heritage within our kingdom."

470.speaker: Sal Ignacius
470.text: "Since you lifted the blasphemy law -- against my advice, I might add -- we have seen increasing numbers of Golcondist practitioners in Rizia."

471.speaker: Player_Romus
471.text: “I hear their condemnation and pray for understanding."

475.speaker: Sal Ignacius
475.text: "Yes. Because nothing says 'world peace' like a sarcastic comment followed by an eye roll."

477.speaker: Player_Romus
477.text: "You're right, and I'm sorry if my attempt at humor was misplaced."

478.speaker: Player_Romus
478.text: "Don't get cute with me. Sarcasm is reserved for your king."

479.speaker: Sal Ignacius
479.text: "The circumstances to which I'm referring are no laughing matter. They must align with the divine order."

480.speaker: Sal Ignacius
480.text: "I appreciate your humility, but as sovereign of this realm, it isn't necessary."

481.speaker: Sal Ignacius
481.text: "I assure you, I am a man of many qualities... 'cute' isn't one of them. In any case..."

482.speaker: Player_Romus
482.text: "Watch your tone. It would be wise to remember your place in this conversation."

483.speaker: Sal Ignacius
483.text: "My apologies if I crossed a line."

484.speaker: Sal Ignacius
484.text: "What I'm trying to say is when it comes to war, there are instances in the scripture where it's deemed just as a means to protect the divine order."

485.speaker: Sal Ignacius
485.text: "In its pursuit of peace, Wruhecism promotes harmony and unity, yet with a nuanced perspective."

486.speaker: Sal Ignacius
486.text: "While our faith promotes peaceful resolutions, it recognizes the complexities of our world."

487.speaker: Sal Ignacius
487.text: "Within the sacred verses, there are instances where war was justified, seen as a necessary safeguard for the divine order."

488.speaker: Sal Ignacius
488.text: "The scriptures acknowledge just wars -- conflicts fought in defense of the divine message or to protect the pillars of enlightenment."

489.speaker: Sal Ignacius
489.text: "The balance between peace, strength, and ambition is a delicate interplay within Wruhecism, but it need not be contrary to these ideals."

490.speaker: Sal Ignacius
490.text: "In the teachings, much like in the context of war, we observe instances of leaders who embodied both strength and a commitment to the divine message."

491.speaker: Player_Romus
491.text: "What if the divine order involves embracing growth and expansion?"

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "Yet we find it throughout our history."

493.speaker: Player_Romus
493.text: "Some might call it a necessary evil."

498.speaker: Sal Ignacius
498.text: "Nevertheless, the divine order acknowledges growth and expansion."

499.speaker: Sal Ignacius
499.text: "Keep in mind that while wealth and territory are earthly pursuits, the divine order transcends material gains."

500.speaker: Sal Ignacius
500.text: "'Growth and expansion?' If I'm being honest, that sounds more like conquest through force."

501.speaker: Sal Ignacius
501.text: "However, it requires that these endeavors be approached with compassion, wisdom, and humility for true harmony."

508.speaker: Sal Ignacius
508.text: "I've been in politics a long time, Your Majesty."

509.speaker: Sal Ignacius
509.text: "But it doesn't make it right or just."

510.speaker: Sal Ignacius
510.text: "Such endeavors must be approached with compassion, wisdom, and humility."

512.speaker: Sal Ignacius
512.text: "The path of righteousness doesn't entertain the notion of necessary evils, but rather challenges us to seek alternative, just solutions."

513.speaker: Sal Ignacius
513.text: "Only if such decisions deviate from the principles we hold dear."

514.speaker: Player_Romus
514.text: "Agreed. They are pillars of guiding lights on our spiritual journey."

515.speaker: Sal Ignacius
515.text: "They lighten our way even in the darkest nights."

516.speaker: Sal Ignacius
516.text: "A duty to protect is sacred, but let us be cautious not to mistake assertiveness for aggression."

519.speaker: Sal Ignacius
519.text: "No, but the scriptures do guide us in discerning the righteous path."

520.speaker: Sal Ignacius
520.text: "If war becomes necessary, it should be approached with solemn determination, guided by righteousness."

521.speaker: Sal Ignacius
521.text: "Exhaustion from conflict is nothing compared to the exhaustion of rebuilding a shattered kingdom."

522.speaker: Sal Ignacius
522.text: "I understand the complexities you face in leading our kingdom."

523.speaker: Sal Ignacius
523.text: "However, caution is needed to secure the integrity of our faith and maintain the trust of our people."

524.speaker: Narrator
524.text: Sal looked at me, his eyes appearing to convey a shared understanding.

525.speaker: Sal Ignacius
525.text: "I strongly encourage you to take time to reflect on this and reconsider."

528.speaker: Player_Romus
528.text: "Rest assured that your concerns will be carefully considered."

529.speaker: Player_Romus
529.text: "I'm still weighing my options and will take your concerns seriously."

530.speaker: Narrator
530.text: Sal hesitated momentarily before bowing in respect.

531.speaker: Player_Romus
531.text: “A secular approach allows for the coexistence of diverse beliefs, promoting tolerance and understanding within our realm.”

532.speaker: Player_Romus
532.text: "But a non-theistic approach would ensure that we protect the beliefs of all our citizens, without imposing one faith over another.”

533.speaker: Player_Romus
533.text: “A secular approach would better protect the freedom of religious expression."

534.speaker: Player_Romus
534.text: "On the contrary, I believe embracing secularism could allow us to build a society where everyone’s beliefs are honored.”

535.speaker: Sal Ignacius
535.text: "How is promoting secularism *not* favoring a particular worldview over others?"

536.speaker: Sal Ignacius
536.text: "However, this may lead to a significant moral decline."

537.speaker: Sal Ignacius
537.text: "Please, Your Majesty. You know how committed I am to the Crown."

538.speaker: Sal Ignacius
538.text: "I'd argue that a more inclusive approach would foster an even richer environment for religious expression."

539.speaker: Player_Romus
539.text: “Taking such an approach is essential to ensure a government that respects all beliefs and promotes unity.”

540.speaker: Player_Romus
540.text: “But an overly religious approach might also fracture the cultural and spiritual foundation that holds our kingdom together.”

541.speaker: Player_Romus
541.text: "Maybe ties should be severed! It's about time something was done about it."

542.speaker: Sal Ignacius
542.text: "I beg to differ. A religious approach can enhance unity rather than sow division."

543.speaker: Sal Ignacius
543.text: "I believe that would instead sow divisions rather than bring our society closer."

544.speaker: Sal Ignacius
544.text: "If that's how you feel about it, I see no reason to continue this debate."

545.speaker: Player_Romus
545.text: "This is the right path for Rizia. I can feel it with every fiber of my being."

546.speaker: Player_Romus
546.text: "And what qualifies you, Grand Wiseman? Do not forget that I am the one whom our Lord God chose to reign over this kingdom."

547.speaker: Sal Ignacius
547.text: "Yes, of course. But I assure you that our goals are entirely in line."

549.speaker: Sal Ignacius
549.text: "Certainly, Your Majesty. I am confident that if we do not alienate them, sooner or later, they will find their way to the one true religion."

550.speaker: Sal Ignacius
550.text: "Does he truly believe, Your Majesty? Or is Wruhecism a mere garment for him that he puts on to appease his province?"

551.speaker: Sal Ignacius
551.text: "Yes, Your Majesty. I will. In the meantime, I will remain optimistic."

555.speaker: Sal Ignacius
555.text: "In any case, it's been a pleasure speaking to you on this grand occasion. I am honored we could witness it together."

556.speaker: Sal Ignacius
556.text: "It's been a pleasure speaking to you on this grand occasion. I am honored we could witness it together."

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "Climbing the ladder, are we, Sal? I didn't take you for the power-hungry type."

561.speaker: Sal Ignacius
561.text: "My loyalty lies in serving you and Rizia. I believe I can do both better by taking on a more proactive role in government."

562.speaker: Sal Ignacius
562.text: "In any case, it's been a pleasure speaking to you on this momentous occasion. I am honored we could witness it together."

564.speaker: Sal Ignacius
564.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I'm pleased to hear it."

565.speaker: Sal Ignacius
565.text: "I trust your judgment to lead us in the right direction."

566.speaker: Sal Ignacius
566.text: "It's been a pleasure speaking to you on this momentous occasion. I am honored that we could witness it together."

567.speaker: Sal Ignacius
567.text: "Despite our differing views, it's been a pleasure speaking to you on this momentous occasion. I am honored that we could witness it together."

568.speaker: Sal Ignacius
568.text: "I don't wish to contradict you, Your Majesty. My duty has, and always will be, to the Crown."

569.speaker: Sal Ignacius
569.text: "I believe that alternate paths would better preserve the spiritual integrity of our realm."

570.speaker: Player_Romus
570.text: "Don't get your hopes up, Grand Wiseman. My decision is unlikely to budge."

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "I must be honest. I don't foresee a change in my decision."

572.speaker: Player_Romus
572.text: "I hear your plea, and will certainly take your words into consideration."

573.speaker: Player_Romus
573.text: "Perhaps there's merit in your words. I'll give due consideration to other possibilities."

577.speaker: Sal Ignacius
577.text: "I'm pleased to hear it. Regardless, my loyalty lies in serving you and Rizia."

578.speaker: Sal Ignacius
578.text: "Be that as it may, I am still here to guide you."

579.speaker: Sal Ignacius
579.text: "Your Majesty, I have faith in your ability to arrive at the most prudent conclusion."

580.speaker: Sal Ignacius
580.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. As always, I'm here to serve."

581.speaker: Sal Ignacius
581.text: "However, I foresee a considerable moral decline as a potential consequence of such an approach."

582.speaker: Sal Ignacius
582.text: "I have no desire to contradict you, Your Majesty. My allegiance remains steadfastly with the crown, as it always has been."

583.speaker: Sal Ignacius
583.text: "I simply believe that alternative paths would better preserve the spiritual integrity of our realm."

584.speaker: Sal Ignacius
584.text: "I value your presence tonight, but I believe the best course is for me to appreciate the rest of this cosmic miracle in quiet solitude."

588.speaker: Sal Ignacius
588.text: "The Derdians' commitment to Golcondism influences every aspect of their daily lives, serving as a cornerstone of their cultural identity."

589.speaker: Sal Ignacius
589.text: "If you seek diplomatic relations with the Derdians, you must prepare to clash with them over our differing interpretations of Wruhecism."

592.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
592.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Homosexuality_Banned"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false

839.text: "Your desire for unity is noted, but my decision stands."

840.speaker: Player_Romus
840.text: "Okay, fine. So where do these groups sway? Are they for or against the Crown?"

841.speaker: Player_Romus
841.text: "Perhaps we’ve been too lenient. Stronger measures may be needed to bring them in line."

842.speaker: Sal Ignacius
842.text: "You could, but that might stoke more resentment toward you."

843.speaker: Player_Romus
843.text: “Public sentiment is fleeting. The Crown’s power is not. I won’t discuss this further.”

844.speaker: Sal Ignacius
844.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. I’ll leave it at that."

846.speaker: Narrator
846.text: The air hung heavy with silence -- Sal visibly disturbed by our exchange. And night grew darker still, veiled by the passing shadow of a cloud.

847.speaker: Player_Romus
847.text: "There's clearly something on your mind, so just say it."

848.speaker: Player_Romus
848.text: "Look, I apologize for my harsh words. I've had a lot on my mind lately, and I unfortunately let some of that frustration out on you."

850.speaker: Sal Ignacius
850.text: "If that is your wish, I won't dwell on the matter any further."

851.speaker: Sal Ignacius
851.text: "I appreciate your apology, Your Majesty. Being king takes its toll."

852.speaker: Narrator
852.text: Another pause fell between us as we overlooked the city below -- a chill breeze added to that discomfort.

856.speaker: Sal Ignacius
856.text: "Your Majesty, if I may speak candidly... I've noticed that Rizia has undergone certain religious shifts during your reign."

857.speaker: Sal Ignacius
857.text: "While I believe you have the kingdom's best interests at heart, I worry that these changes might inadvertently erode the sanctity and devotion traditionally linked with our one true faith."

858.speaker: Sal Ignacius
858.text: "If I may speak candidly, Your Majesty, I find your commitment to the traditional values of Wruhecism most inspiring."
858.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religion_DontCareAboutPublicOpinion"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religion_MightStokeResentment"] == true) == false)

859.speaker: Sal Ignacius
859.text: "And I believe that continuing down this path will not only honor our history but also cultivate a sense of unity and purpose among our people."
859.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == false  and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishDerdianBan"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Wehlen_Terrorism_BludishBan"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Completed"] == false)) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false)

860.speaker: Sal Ignacius
860.text: "Moreover, it will foster inspirational loyalty and a shared devotion that will stand as a beacon for generations to come."

861.speaker: Player_Romus
861.text: "It's our shared principles that guide our kingdom's path."

862.speaker: Player_Romus
862.text: "A beacon, huh? If that's what you think, I won't contest it."

869.speaker: Player_Romus
869.text: "I thought I was just stubbornly clinging to tradition, but if it inspires greatness, who am I to argue?"

870.speaker: Player_Romus
870.text: "Divine guidance shapes our kingdom's path. Trusting in sacred values ensures our realm's prosperity."

871.speaker: Player_Romus
871.text: "Loyalty isn't rooted in faith, but from authority."

872.speaker: Player_Romus
872.text: "Loyalty derives from the judicious application of authority."

876.speaker: Sal Ignacius
876.text: "Let us not forget the divine authority that governs us all."

877.speaker: Sal Ignacius
877.text: "True loyalty stems from a higher calling that aligns our hearts with the sacred principles of Wruhecism."

878.speaker: Sal Ignacius
878.text: "In recognizing the divine authority, we can forge a kingdom bound not just by earthly control but by a spiritual one that transcends the temporal."

879.speaker: Player_Romus
879.text: "If the invisible hand of divine judgment is what it takes to keep people in line, then we shall proceed unchanged."

880.speaker: Player_Romus
880.text: "Regardless of whether we're constrained by earthly or heavenly rules, both can be readily bent to secure one's goals."

881.speaker: Player_Romus
881.text: "Our kingdom's strength is in the steadfast loyalty of its subjects. First and foremost, I want them to have faith in *me*."

882.speaker: Player_Romus
882.text: "Which is why I see no reason to change course regarding the role religion plays in our kingdom."

883.speaker: Player_Romus
883.text: "That said, I still believe religion in Rizia is sacred -- a cornerstone I have no intention of altering."

884.speaker: Player_Romus
884.text: "Which is why, when it comes to religion's place in this kingdom, I intend to leave my options open."

885.speaker: Sal Ignacius
885.text: "You have already taken the first steps on this journey of enlightenment. It would be an honor for me to accompany you further."

886.speaker: Sal Ignacius
886.text: "I'm pleased to hear it. The flourishing of our realm is tied to the steadfast commitment to Wruhecism's teachings."

887.speaker: Sal Ignacius
887.text: "That's reassuring to hear. The prosperity of our kingdom is closely linked to our steadfast devotion to the teachings of Wruhecism."

888.speaker: Sal Ignacius
888.text: "That's welcoming news. The flourishing of our realm is intricately tied to the steadfast commitment to Wruhecism's teachings."

889.speaker: Sal Ignacius
889.text: "With all due respect, nothing good can come from any deviation from the sacred principles that have guided our realm for centuries."

890.speaker: Sal Ignacius
890.text: "Are you suggesting that we alter the established religious order, one that has stood unchanged for centuries?"

891.speaker: Player_Romus
891.text: "I intend to evolve our religious traditions thoughtfully, ensuring they remain meaningful and unifying for all."

892.speaker: Sal Ignacius
892.text: "Idealistic, however, the practicality of achieving such an endeavor is rife with challenges. But not impossible."

893.speaker: Sal Ignacius
893.text: "While I'm unapologetically partial to Rizia as a Wruhecist state, I will concede that there is more than one approach that could be considered."

894.speaker: Sal Ignacius
894.text: "With both Wruhecism and Dastnurity at the helm, I'd imagine."

895.speaker: Sal Ignacius
895.text: "Let's not overlook the divine authority that guides us all."

897.speaker: Sal Ignacius
897.text: "I just want to say -- if I may speak candidly -- I find your commitment to upholding the traditional values of Wruhecism most inspiring."
897.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_WruhecistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_RemoveGolcondistBlasphemyLaw"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religion_DontCareAboutPublicOpinion"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religion_MightStokeResentment"] == true)

903.speaker: Player_Romus
903.text: "What it comes down to is that I'm willing to do whatever it takes to get Derdia and Morella to settle their border disputes."

904.speaker: Player_Romus
904.text: "Anyway, the point is Rizia needs military help from Derdia for our war with Pales. We just need to ensure it benefits them as well."

905.speaker: Player_Romus
905.text: "Nevertheless, I simply want to improve our diplomatic relations in any way, shape, or form."

909.speaker: Player_Romus
909.text: "Speaking of divine justice... you've made the case that war can be justified... but what about murder?"

911.speaker: Player_Romus
911.text: "Curious... you say that war, depending on the situation can be justified. But what about murder?"

912.speaker: Narrator
912.text: I looked up again to see if the clouds had dispersed, which they had not, and I let out a sigh.

913.speaker: Narrator
913.text: It seemed at the rate things were progressing, it would be morning before the skies would be free from obstruction.

914.speaker: Narrator
914.text: I shifted my gaze back to the palace, a place that brought memories of my father and where he drew his last breath.

915.speaker: Narrator
915.text: And how the man standing before me could have played a direct role in his demise.

916.speaker: Sal Ignacius
916.text: "Wruhecism emphasizes the sanctity of life, but it also acknowledges the harsh realities of our world, such as war."

917.speaker: Sal Ignacius
917.text: "However, murder is an unjustified killing and stands in direct contradiction to the teachings of Wruhecism."

918.speaker: Player_Romus
918.text: "So, in the eyes of our faith, there's a distinction between the two?"

919.speaker: Player_Romus
919.text: "Speaking of being tested... do you think you could ever do it? Kill someone?"

920.speaker: Sal Ignacius
920.text: "Our faith acknowledges tough decisions in war but condemns unjust killing outside of those situations."

921.speaker: Sal Ignacius
921.text: "Testing the boundaries of Divine principles is a delicate balance."

922.speaker: Sal Ignacius
922.text: "Purposefully take a life? Your Majesty, I am a man of peace, and seek whatever path that best leads me to that goal."

923.speaker: Sal Ignacius
923.text: "However, I will acknowledge that extreme circumstances may warrant taking equally extreme measures."

924.speaker: Player_Romus
924.text: "Interesting. Well, let's hope it never comes to that."

925.speaker: Sal Ignacius
925.text: "Murder is an unjustified killing, and stands in direct contradiction to the teachings of Wruhecism."

927.speaker: Player_Romus
927.text: "And how does one decide what is just and what isn't?"

928.speaker: Player_Romus
928.text: "I must say, the deeper my comprehension of Wruhecism, the more contradictions appear to surface."

929.speaker: Player_Romus
929.text: "There's a certain convenience in the divine texts' cryptic vagueness, as if deliberately leaving room for interpretation."

930.speaker: Player_Romus
930.text: "Even if it was for the greater good? Like a homicidal maniac or a cruel despot, perhaps?"

931.speaker: Player_Romus
931.text: "When it comes to protecting our kingdom, I won't hesitate to make the necessary decisions. What would you do in my position?"

932.speaker: Sal Ignacius
932.text: "First of all, I could never fill your shoes."

933.speaker: Sal Ignacius
933.text: "Our religion fundamentally cherishes life. However, in facing an extreme threat, the ethical dilemma becomes complex."

934.speaker: Sal Ignacius
934.text: "Only for those who wish to see it that way. To me, the answer is clear."

936.speaker: Sal Ignacius
936.text: "Our faith may allow for self-defense, but it's crucial to ensure the intention is genuinely for the greater good and not veering into unjustifiable violence."

937.speaker: Player_Romus
937.text: "Noted. Let's hope circumstances never force us into such a predicament."

941.speaker: Player_Romus
941.text: "Well fortunately for us, there's a shortage of homicidal maniacs in Rizia. As for cruel despots... I suppose that's still up for debate."

942.speaker: Sal Ignacius
942.text: "I'll let you know if I see one."

943.speaker: Narrator
943.text: It was hard to discern Sal's true sentiments behind his half-hearted smile.

945.speaker: Player_Romus
945.text: "Direct and to the point. I like it."

946.speaker: Player_Romus
946.text: "Excellent. I'm pleased we've established clarity on that."

948.speaker: Player_Romus
948.text: "I believe decisive actions are sometimes imperative. How do you envision handling such situations if you were in my position?"

952.speaker: Sal Ignacius
952.text: "And secondly, I would need more context to such a hypothetical situation before answering."

954.speaker: Sal Ignacius
954.text: "As always, that's your prerogative, Your Majesty."

955.speaker: Sal Ignacius
955.text: "I'm glad I could be of service."

956.speaker: Sal Ignacius
956.text: "Well, on top of needing more context, I would handle such scenarios on a case-by-case basis before answering."

957.speaker: Player_Romus
957.text: "I see. Well, I do hope such dilemmas never present themselves."

959.speaker: Player_Romus
959.text: "Simple. The context being, to kill or not to kill?"

960.speaker: Sal Ignacius
960.text: "Seeing as how you're God's representative on earth, I'll leave it up to you to decide."

964.speaker: Sal Ignacius
964.text: "As Rizia's sovereign leader, I'll leave it up to you to decide."

965.speaker: Player_Romus
965.text: "A simple answer to a complex problem. Fascinating..."

966.speaker: Sal Ignacius
966.text: "I prefer prayer to hope, though it still has it's value."

967.speaker: Sal Ignacius
967.text: "The Divine laws can be understood without always resorting to a parable."

968.speaker: Sal Ignacius
968.text: "Because the most complex of problems are more often than not resolved by such simplicity."

969.speaker: Player_Romus
969.text: "Interesting. Well, let's pray it never comes to that."

974.speaker: Sal Ignacius
974.text: "Through prayer and devotion to the almighty. Keep in mind..."

975.speaker: Sal Ignacius
975.text: "That's because because we are simply not meant to comprehend every aspect of God's plan."

976.speaker: Player_Romus
976.text: "You've made the case that war can be justified... but what about killing someone in cold blood?"

977.speaker: Narrator
977.text: We stood together in contemplative silence as we overlooked the city below.

978.speaker: Player_Romus
978.text: "Anyway, the point is Rizia needs help from Derdia regarding Zille. We just need to ensure it benefits them as well."
978.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_SuOminaActive"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_ATAActive"] == true)

979.speaker: Sal Ignacius
979.text: "As it should, Your Majesty. No man of God makes use of violence without it weighing heavily on his conscience."

981.speaker: Sal Ignacius
981.text: "It goes without saying that the last thing we want is an escalation of violence between the two nations."

982.speaker: Sal Ignacius
982.text: "In any case... it goes without saying that the last thing we want is an escalation of violence between the two nations."

983.speaker: Sal Ignacius
983.text: "I think you'll agree when I say that the last thing we need is another adversary on our doorstep."

984.speaker: Sal Ignacius
984.text: "The last thing we need is another adversary on our doorstep. But I will speak of it no more."

985.speaker: Sal Ignacius
985.text: "It goes without saying that the last thing we need is another adversary on our doorstep."

986.speaker: Sal Ignacius
986.text: "And the last thing we need is another adversary on our doorstep."

987.speaker: Player_Romus
987.text: "I'm confused. Are we here to talk foreign affairs, or watch an interplanetary alignment?"

988.speaker: Player_Romus
988.text: "We all desire peace and harmony, but realism dictates we must resort to force if needed. Yet, it still leaves me deeply conflicted."

989.speaker: Player_Romus
989.text: "I appreciate your input, but international relations fall under Laurento's purview. Let's stick to religion, shall we?"

990.speaker: Sal Ignacius
990.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. I was merely offering an honest evaluation."

994.speaker: Sal Ignacius
994.text: "Well, Your Majesty, I suppose it's a unique approach to inspiration."

996.speaker: Player_Romus
996.text: "Prioritizing earthly laws over celestial ones may be imperative to achieving unity."

997.speaker: Sal Ignacius
997.text: "Through the acknowledgment of divine authority, we can create a kingdom united by earthly as well as spiritual governance."

998.speaker: Sal Ignacius
998.text: "Are you proposing a change to a time-honored religious order that has remained steadfast for centuries?"

999.speaker: Player_Romus
999.text: "I'm not suggesting we make any drastic changes. Only that we keep our options open.”

1000.speaker: Player_Romus
1000.text: "Hold your heavenly horses, Sal. I'm not suggesting we make any drastic changes, only that we keep our options open.”

1004.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1004.text: "Our guiding principals are etched in stone, resistant to erosion, signifying their unchanging nature."

1005.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1005.text: "However, I will concede that even stone can be sculpted with thoughtful craftsmanship when necessary. Or to put it more plainly..."

1006.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1006.text: "Nevertheless, by acknowledging divine authority, we create a kingdom united in earthly governance and spiritual depth."

1007.speaker: Player_Romus
1007.text: "And how would you decipher the cosmic narrative of those loyal subjects?"

1008.speaker: Player_Romus
1008.text: "The people's narrative isn't difficult to interpret. Their needs are as simple as they are elementary, much like deciphering a children's bedtime story."

1009.speaker: Player_Romus
1009.text: "Understanding the inner workings of my people is a goal I strive for. But more often than not, it proves elusive."

1010.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1010.text: "If we're speaking spiritually, faith holds a unique place in their hearts and is as diverse as the stars above. As for their prevailing sentiments..."

1011.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1011.text: "Religion is never simple, Your Majesty. Especially in a country full of different belief systems."

1012.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1012.text: "Then, with your permission, allow me to shed some light on the subject -- at least spiritually."

1013.speaker: Player_Romus
1013.text: "Go ahead. Enlighten me. It looks like we're going to be here a while, so let's make the best of it."

1014.speaker: Narrator
1014.text: I looked toward the sky. It had yet to clear up.

1015.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1015.text: "Certainly, Your Majesty. As for their overall prevailing sentiments..."

1017.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1017.text: "Very well. I'd be happy to give you an overview of the prevailing sentiments within our religious communities."

1022.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1022.text: "For example, I believe that re-allowing Golcondists into our precious Archsanctuaries has unleashed the potential for perilous radicalism within the realm."

1023.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1023.text: "Simply put, I feel that your priorities as king are not as aligned with our kingdom's Wruhecist roots as they should be."

1024.text: "I urge you not to underestimate the power of our cherished religious traditions and to reconsider the role of Wruhecism in government."

1028.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1028.text: "Your support for the reconstruction of the Archsanctuary of Plavo is a testament to that commitment."

1032.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1032.text: "Your support for the reconstruction of the Archsanctuary of Plavo is another example."

1033.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1033.text: "Your willingness to uphold our anti-blasphemy laws speaks volumes about your dedication."

1059.speaker: Sal Ignacius
