1060.speaker: Player_Romus
1060.text: "And that's precisely why I am committed to ensuring that our kingdom truly embodies a life of piety."

1061.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1061.text: "I'm pleased to hear it. The prosperity of our realm is interwoven with our resolute commitment to the tenets of Wruhecism."

1062.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1062.text: "Anything short of it would be a mistake, jeopardizing our shared values."

1063.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1063.text: "In this case, as previously mentioned, specifically rooted in both Wruhecism and Dastnurity."

1064.speaker: Player_Romus
1064.text: "If Rizia had implemented a pluralistic system when we were married, my late wife wouldn't have converted to Wruhecism from Dastnurity."

1065.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1065.text: "As always, you have my most sincere condolences. However, I urge you to set your personal feelings aside and take a pragmatic approach."

1069.speaker: Player_Romus
1069.text: "Furthermore, there are other Crown-affiliated individuals with leanings toward Dastnurity. Should they be considered second-class citizens?"

1070.speaker: Player_Romus
1070.text: "And I know others who practice Dastnurity. While I won't reveal their identities, I believe they would support Wruhecism and Dastnurity's coexistence."

1071.speaker: Player_Romus
1071.text: "And she wasn't the only one. There are others who walk the palace and practice Dastnurity."

1072.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1072.text: "Wruhecism has provided a stable foundation for our kingdom for generations, and I see no reason to deviate from that path."

1073.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1073.text: "I'm not implying they should be second-class anything. I'm simply saying that..."

1074.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1074.text: "I have no doubt those individuals would welcome such a change with open arms. But I don't."

1075.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1075.text: "Yet I still see no reason to make such drastic concession for a minority religion."

1076.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1076.text: "By issuing government mandates aligned with Wruhecist principals,  you could ensure its teachings reach every corner of our kingdom."
1076.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false)

1080.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1080.text: "By issuing government mandates that align with Wruhecist principles, you could ensure widespread dissemination of its teachings."
1080.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true) == false)

1084.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1084.text: "By enforcing Wruhecist principles through government mandates, we could disseminate its teachings widely."

1085.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1085.text: "But I confess I don't see that as a positive development. Their radical beliefs -- especially those of Derdian Golcondists -- are incompatible with the Rizian way of life."

1086.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1086.text: "To be honest, you should not do more to feed into their fervor. Their radical beliefs -- especially those of Derdian Golcondists -- are incompatible with the Rizian way of life."

1088.speaker: Player_Romus
1088.text: "Rizia's present spiritual connections serve as a manipulative tool, akin to extremist doctrines' deceptive narratives."

1089.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1089.text: "You speak of extremist doctrine, yet you spout far-left talking points."

1090.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1090.text: "I'm sorry, Your Majesty. While I value you joining me tonight, I think it's best that I enjoy the rest of this cosmic phenomenon alone."

1093.speaker: Player_Romus
1093.text: "Those beacons cannot help me. Where I am, it's too dark to find my way."

1094.speaker: Player_Romus
1094.text: "The Alignment, Sal. It speaks to me."

1095.speaker: Player_Romus
1095.text: "Now I know how St. Wruhec felt all those years ago."

1096.speaker: Player_Romus
1096.text: "Basic astronomy, Sal. That's all it is."

1097.speaker: Narrator
1097.text: Sal was too enthralled with the spectacle to hear me.

1098.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1098.text: "The six tenets of Wruhecism, Your Majesty. Each of them a guiding beacon in the darkness, shedding light on our past and the days to come."

1099.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1099.text: "And yet the planets above us glow all the same."

1100.speaker: Narrator
1100.text: The Wiseman's look of wonder and awe quickly turned into a scowl.

1102.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1102.text: "I'm afraid to ask, but am compelled to anyway..."

1103.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1103.text: "After all of our talk, what are your thoughts on our kingdom's religious governance?"

1104.speaker: Narrator
1104.text: I remembered the visions Sal foretold during the Consecration of the King ceremony.

1105.speaker: Narrator
1105.text: Fractured crowns, soldiers and war, the lovers…

1106.speaker: Narrator
1106.text: Swarms of birds and three-headed monsters…

1107.speaker: Player_Romus
1107.text: "It's as meaningless as the visions you spoke of in the catacombs."

1111.speaker: Player_Romus
1111.text: "Much like your visions in the catacombs, the Alignment speaks to me."

1121.speaker: Narrator
1121.text: The circumstances weighed on me. I thought carefully about how to progress.

1123.speaker: Narrator
1123.text: As my mind roiled with questions, the heavens seemed to respond.

1127.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1127.text: "You are clearly a man of faith. Is it your intention to further infuse that faith into all aspects of this kingdom's government?"

1128.speaker: Titus Gordion
1128.text: "I'm sorry that we didn't share a similar experience."

1129.speaker: Titus Gordion
1129.text: "I'm sorry that we did not share a similar experience of the event."

1130.speaker: Titus Gordion
1130.text: "I'm sorry we didn't share a similar experience."

1131.speaker: Titus Gordion
1131.text: "I'm glad to hear we shared a similar experience."

1132.speaker: Titus Gordion
1132.text: "Well, I hoped you were as moved as I was."

1133.speaker: Titus Gordion
1133.text: "I do hope you were moved as much as I was."

1134.speaker: Player_Romus
1134.text: "Indeed. The Alignment of the Six Stars has not only graced us with its ethereal beauty but illuminated the path I am to embark upon."

1135.speaker: Player_Romus
1135.text: "The Alignment fills me with optimism for the future."

1136.speaker: Player_Romus
1136.text: "The Alignment of the Six Stars did nothing but shroud the path I was about to embark upon in darkness. That's all."

1137.speaker: Player_Romus
1137.text: "If anything, I feel more pessimistic about the future -- the misalignment of faith, governance, and the celestial forces above, to name a few."

1139.speaker: Narrator
1139.text: Titus didn't say another word for the rest of our drive.

1140.speaker: Narrator
1140.text: For the rest of our drive, Titus and I discussed destiny and the intricate workings of fate as guided by the stars above.

1146.text: "Our conversation provided no conclusive evidence to support a connection into my father's death."

1147.speaker: Titus Gordion
1147.text: "Thanks for letting me know. However, in the future, I'd advise you to let the Golden Guard handle the investigation."

1148.speaker: Player_Romus
1148.text: "Unfortunately, the grand wiseman has a sharp wit about him and didn't confess to anything. But I still harbor suspicions."

1149.speaker: Player_Romus
1149.text: "I'm convinced Sal was involved with my father's death, given how evasive he was with my inquires surrounding the matter."

1150.speaker: Narrator
1150.text: As I stepped out of the room, Titus greeted me with a brief bow.

1151.speaker: Titus Gordion
1151.text: "I hope everything went as expected, sir."

1152.speaker: Narrator
1152.text: With Sal's guards standing nearby, I waited until Titus and I were halfway down the stairs before replying.
1152.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateSal"] == true  and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religion_MurderandWarTalk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religious_QuestionSalMurder"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true

1153.speaker: Titus Gordion
1153.text: "Appreciate the update. Going forward, I strongly recommend allowing the Golden Guard to manage the investigation."

1154.speaker: Titus Gordion
1154.text: "Thanks for keeping me informed. Going forward, I strongly recommend entrusting the investigation to the Golden Guard."

1156.speaker: Player_Romus
1156.text: "Oh, yes. The alignment was quite a sight to behold. You'll see."
1156.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateSal"] == true  and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religion_MurderandWarTalk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religious_QuestionSalMurder"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_ReligiousKing"] == true) == false)

1157.speaker: Player_Romus
1157.text: "More or less. Though, I would have been just as happy to read about the alignment in tomorrow's paper."
1157.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_InvestigateSal"] == true  and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religion_MurderandWarTalk"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Briefing_Religious_QuestionSalMurder"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true) == false

1158.speaker: Player_Romus
1158.text: "If by 'went as expected' you mean listening to an old man drone on a on about nothing, then yes."

1164.speaker: Player_Romus
1164.text: "Enough talk about Derdia. It's giving me a headache."

1165.speaker: Player_Romus
1165.text: "In any case, I seek no diplomatic or material benefits. Instead, I aim to strengthen spiritual ties given our nations' profound religious connections."

1166.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1166.text: "Religion may be deeply intertwined with our two cultures, but, as I've said before, our beliefs are vastly different, and would advise caution."

1167.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1167.text: "Not to mention... such a move may cast us in an unfavorable light among our international partners."

1169.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

1170.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1170.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_SuOminaActive"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_ATAActive"] == true) == false

1171.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1171.text: "Given the ongoing conflicts we are involved in, the last thing we need is increased tensions that could spill over into violence."

1172.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1172.text: "The last thing we need is increased tension that could spill over into violence."
1172.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_SuOminaActive"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_ATAActive"] == true) == false

1174.speaker: Player_Romus
1174.text: "In all seriousness, If the sacred text justifies war, I'll approach this conflict with careful adherence to Wruhecistic principles."

1178.speaker: Player_Romus
1178.text: "Yes, yes... Of course. If the sacred text provides just cause for war, we must carefully follow its principles."

1179.speaker: Player_Romus
1179.text: "Look, I think prayer is as effective as shouting at the wind. It's like trying to find religious justification for war -- it doesn't hold up."

1180.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1180.text: "Well, I appreciate your candor. I'll hold on to the belief and pray that one day our perspectives may align."

1182.speaker: Player_Romus
1182.text: "Look, I believe prayer does as much good as shouting at the wind. Same as trying to evoke a justification for war through religious doctrine and beliefs."

1186.speaker: Narrator
1186.text: It was going to be difficult to get my mind off of Vina's ongoing captivity in Pales. But I had to try.

1187.speaker: Player_Romus
1187.text: "Thanks, but I'd rather not talk about it."

1191.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1191.text: "I also wanted to let you know that Vina is in my thoughts and prayers. What Pales did was truly barbaric."

1192.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1192.text: "Say no more. As I was saying..."

1193.speaker: Player_Romus
1193.text: "Save your prayers for someone else. It won't do any good."

1194.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1194.text: "I can see you're deeply troubled. I won't bring it up again. But as I was saying..."

1195.speaker: Player_Romus
1195.text: "Much appreciated. It's been difficult, but I have faith she'll return home safely."

1202.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1202.text: "Overall, while you're not on the Golcondists' bad side, you're not on their good side either."

1206.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1206.text: "They harbor no negative feelings toward you, yet they haven't developed strong positive impressions either."

1214.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1214.text: "However, expanding the Grandsanctuary of Sallabes has greatly boosted Your Majesty's popularity in the community."

1215.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1215.text: "His tone is one of cautious optimism, Your Majesty. The Wruhecist community's needs are met, but there is much more the Crown could do for them."

1216.speaker: Player_Romus
1216.text: "God has spoken to me. The only viable path forward is to establish a holy kingdom governed by the doctrine of Wruhecism."

1218.speaker: Narrator
1218.text: Sal's face gleamed with a radiance surpassing that of the stars above.

1222.speaker: Player_Romus
1222.text: "I can't commit to any intention right now, Sal."

1223.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1223.text: "Understandable. Nevertheless, I shall remain your loyal and trusted advisor."

1224.speaker: Player_Romus
1224.text: "Are there certain circumstances where it be justified?"

1225.speaker: Player_Romus
1225.text: "Oh, quit pretending like you don't know what I'm talking about."

1226.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1226.text: "Well, if you're hinting at its association with armed hostility..."

1227.speaker: Player_Romus
1227.text: "We might have to resort to violent actions in Zille. Could you advise me on the matter?"

1228.speaker: Player_Romus
1228.text: "There is a war on the horizon. How will our faith handle this?"

1229.speaker: Player_Romus
1229.text: "I seek some guidance regarding our escalating tensions."

1233.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1233.text: "But if your mind is made up, so be it."

1234.speaker: Narrator
1234.text: I immediately recalled the revelation about my mother's faith.

1235.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1235.text: "In fact... toward the end of his life, your father and I discussed the possibility that religion wasn't playing a large enough role in governance."

1236.speaker: Player_Romus
1236.text: "A future leader... are you referring to me?"

1237.speaker: Player_Romus
1237.text: "Good for the Rezenids. But a modern king won't be taken seriously if he develops too much of a God complex."

1238.speaker: Player_Romus
1238.text: "I am trying to make Rizia a better place through my policies. Not through centuries-old doctrine."

1239.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1239.text: "A certain possibility. However, my visions have yet to bring clarity on the matter."

1240.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1240.text: "It is not a God complex if one is merely fulfilling the plan that He has written."

1241.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1241.text: "I would argue that there is a place in this kingdom for both."

1247.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1247.text: "It goes without saying that I would keep Rizia united under the principles of Wruhecism."

1251.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1251.text: "Well, for starters, to once again unite Rizia under the principles of Wruhecism."

1255.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1255.text: "With God's help, I believe we should, once again, reunite under the banner of Wruhecism."

1259.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1259.text: "And I appreciate your commitment to a thorough understanding."

1260.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1260.text: "As for available choices... Firstly, we could, once again, reunite under the banner of Wruhecism, cultivating a powerful and cohesive Rizian identity."

1261.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1261.text: "I shall first speak of the prevailing religious factions within Rizia, and their opinions of the Crown."

1265.speaker: Player_Romus
1265.text: "Tell me more about Derdia. I still haven't decided whether Supreme Wiseman Azmal is worth speaking to."

1266.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1266.text: "I will do my best to fill you in, Your Majesty."

1268.speaker: Player_Romus
1268.text: "Enough about what Rizia's religious communities think of me. I want to know the opinion of Grand Wiseman Sal Ignacius."

1269.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1269.text: "I am honored that you would want to know it, Your Majesty."

1278.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1278.text: "The Rezenids recognized how holy this land was. Their ancient scripture spoke of a future leader who would serve as a conduit between God and the people and bring about Golconda."

1279.speaker: Player_Romus
1279.text: "A future leader... could that be me?"

1280.speaker: Player_Romus
1280.text: "Good for the Rezenids. But a modern king won't be taken seriously if he develops too much of a God complex."

1281.speaker: Player_Romus
1281.text: "I am trying to make Rizia a better place through my policies. Not through centuries-old doctrine."

1282.speaker: Sal Ignacius

1283.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1283.text: "It is not a God complex if one is merely fulfilling the plan that He has written."

1284.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1284.text: "I would argue that there is a place in this kingdom for both."

1346.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Happy"] == true) == false)

1348.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1348.text: "You need not worry too much about your reputation among Dastnurists, Your Majesty. They are but a minority."

1349.speaker: Player_Romus
1349.text: "Should I be doing more to bring them into the fold?"

1350.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1350.text: "Fostering a more inclusive religious atmosphere in Rizia is all well and good, Your Majesty..."

1351.speaker: Player_Romus
1351.text: "Sounds like I've got the Dastnurists under control, then."
1351.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_NonWruhecistReligiousTax"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Religion_EnforcedWruhecistEducation"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Happy"] == true)

1352.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1352.text: "You could say that. But you should remain watchful that your actions are perceived as sincere gestures, not calculated moves."

1353.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1353.text: "Acceptance among non-Wruhecist practitioners is indeed key to fostering unity within Rizia."

1354.speaker: Player_Romus
1354.text: "Not this again. Winning back Zille is more important to me than appeasing a tiny religious fringe."

1356.speaker: Player_Romus
1356.text: "Perhaps the ban was unwise. But what's done is done."

1357.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1357.text: "There may yet come a chance to undo it. But I am with Wehlen in recognizing the threat Golcondists pose."

1358.speaker: Player_Romus
1358.text: "It is a counter-terrorism measure. Not a religious ban."

1359.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1359.text: "Your Majesty, even if it were a religious ban, it would be completely justified."

1360.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1360.text: "I would advise vigilance. Their radical beliefs -- especially those of Derdian Golcondists -- mean they may cause trouble if their needs are not met."

1361.speaker: Player_Romus
1361.text: "I'm growing weary of this talk. Can we sit in silence until the alignment?"

1362.speaker: Narrator
1362.text: Sal looked wounded but nodded his assent.

1363.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1363.text: "As you wish, Your Majesty. I will say just one more thing."

1364.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1364.text: "Suffice it to say that I am *very* open to discussing this role with you."

1368.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1368.text: "Your actions on behalf of Rizia's Wruhecist community have been truly admirable thus far."

1369.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1369.text: "Rizia was founded as a Wruhecist nation. I fear we have begun to deviate from our roots."

1370.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1370.text: "I urge you not to underestimate the importance of our cherished religious traditions. And perhaps even to re-commit to the role of Wruhecism in government."

1371.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1371.text: "As the King, you have the power to shape Rizia's religious destiny. You must wield it wisely."

1377.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1377.text: "I must confess, I took the failure to repair the Archsanctuary of Plavo following our visit rather personally."

1387.speaker: Narrator
1387.text: It served as a relic of Rizia's bygone era when the night sky's wonders were more easily unveiled.

1388.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1388.text: "Wruhecism, as the guiding force, has provided a stable foundation for our kingdom."

1389.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1389.text: "This approach might strip away the distinct and divine influence that Wruhecism brings to our decision-making."

1390.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1390.text: "But again, I would be wary of such an approach."

1391.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1391.text: "Given the historical success of our religious roots, it begs the question..."

1392.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1392.text: "Their ancient scripture spoke of a future leader who would bring about Golconda by serving as a conduit between God and the people."

1393.speaker: Narrator
1393.text: Sal raised a knowing smile, hinting at a deeper implication in his words.

1397.speaker: Player_Romus
1397.text: "Romus the Conduit! I could get used to that."

1398.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1398.text: "Well, Your Majesty, it does have a certain ring to it."

1399.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1399.text: "Educational reforms, cultural events, and even economic incentives, to name a few."

1401.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1401.text: "As long as it is not achieved at the expense of Wruhecists."

1402.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1402.text: "But you must take care not to do so at the expense of our foundational Wruhecist values."

1403.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1403.text: "But I believe our religion can and should play a much larger role in the kingdom."

1404.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1404.text: "Wruhecism stresses the importance of peace and the quest for harmony."

1405.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1405.text: "While it may unveil new horizons, uncertainty conceals potential dangers."

1406.speaker: Narrator
1406.text: Below, the city hushed as onlookers collectively witnessed the extraordinary phenomenon.

1407.speaker: Narrator
1407.text: The thick clouds that veiled the sky suddenly dispersed, revealing the fabled Alignment.

1408.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1408.text: "Rizia is a Wruhecist country first and foremost, and our core values should not be weakened."

1409.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1409.text: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, declaring neutrality *is* taking a side."

1410.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1410.text: "I'm sorry to say that I cannot endorse this point of view. It would risk severing the ties that bind us culturally and spiritually."

1411.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1411.text: "Taxing non-Wruhecists and mandating Wruhecist education exemplify this approach."

1412.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1412.text: "Taxing non-Wruhecists is a prime example of this approach."

1413.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1413.text: "Your mandate for Wruhecist education exemplifies this approach."

1414.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1414.text: "Someone who has devoted every moment of his life to studying and comprehending the nuances of Wruhecism."

1415.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1415.text: "But I do hope you will keep this possibility in mind when the time comes."

1416.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1416.text: "I've been immersed in arrangements for tonight's holiest of events."

1417.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1417.text: "With spiritual brilliance, he condensed the 11 Pillars into six, aligning them with the celestial bodies, now recognized as planets."

1421.speaker: Narrator
1421.text: It was going to be difficult to get my mind off of the impending war. But I had to try.

1426.speaker: Titus Gordion
1426.text: "They say that God is never closer to us than He is during the Alignment. Perhaps He will grace you with enlightenment."

1430.speaker: Narrator
1430.text: As I watched him, I thought about what Lucita had told me regarding his possible role in my father's death.
1430.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_MurderInvest_SuspectSal"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigation_Continues"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PoisonInvestigator_Titus"] == true) == false)

1434.speaker: Narrator
1434.text: He was no longer under investigation. But the question of why he was meeting with my father so frequently still hung in the air.

1446.speaker: Player_Romus
1446.text: "I really ought to rename the event the 'Alignment of the Six Planets.'"

1447.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1447.text: "Do you think so? I find 'stars' more poetic, even if our modern knowledge has proven the term inaccurate."

1451.speaker: Player_Romus
1451.text: "Alas, the Lord has ordered dark clouds to obscure the heavens!"

1452.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1452.text: "Only to make the Alignment more majestic when it is finally revealed. You shall see."

1456.speaker: Player_Romus
1456.text: "That's what your secret meetings were about?"

1457.speaker: Narrator
1457.text: He looked at me in mild surprise.

1458.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1458.text: "We had several private conversations on the topic, yes."

1459.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1459.text: "Such a great religious transformation would upset many in the Palace. We thought it best to stay away from prying ears."

1463.speaker: Player_Romus
1463.text: "That's what your secret meetings were about?"

1464.speaker: Narrator
1464.text: He looked at me in mild surprise.

1465.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1465.text: "We had several private conversations on the topic, yes."

1466.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1466.text: "Such a great religious transformation would upset many in the Palace. We thought it best to stay away from prying ears."

1467.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1467.text: "What goes on in the Republic of Derdia has little to do with real religion, Your Majesty."

1468.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1468.text: "As Rizia's premier religious leader, I naturally have an interest in preserving Wruhecist values. But I also truly believe that it is the way."

1469.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1469.text: "You are the king, Your Majesty. How our religion manifests itself in society is up to you."

1474.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
1474.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PlavoRestoration_HireInternationalExperts"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PlavoRestoration_HirePorteDrazonExperts"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PlavoRestoration_HireRomusTorasExperts"] == true) == false

1475.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1475.text: "Once construction is completed, it shall be even more beautiful than before. I have faith in our efforts."
1475.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PlavoRestoration_HireInternationalExperts"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PlavoRestoration_HirePorteDrazonExperts"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PlavoRestoration_HireRomusTorasExperts"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_PlavoSanctuaryRestoration_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Floating_PlavoRestoration_None"] == true) == false)

1480.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1480.text: "I didn't think it possible, but the renewed edifice is even more beautiful than before. The faithful are truly happy with your efforts."

1487.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1487.text: "Your commitment to constructing new houses of worship for St. Wruhec's followers has paid off. Congregations across Rizia are thriving."

1491.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1491.text: "The fact that the Archsanctuary of Plavo continues to deteriorate has not sat well with them."

1495.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1495.text: "If you ask me, they should be more grateful for the other sanctuaries the Crown has blessed them with."

1499.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1499.text: "And they are equally grateful for the other sanctuaries the Crown has blessed them with. As they should be."

1503.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1503.text: "Building a new sanctuary for them has thankfully taken some pressure off Wruhecist places of worship, but it did nothing to stop them from invading Plavo once more..."

1504.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1504.text: "Building new sanctuaries for them has thankfully taken some pressure off Wruhecist places of worship, but it did nothing to stop them from invading Plavo once more..."

1508.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1508.text: "They are invading our sacred spaces. Including Plavo, as if they learned nothing from their previous misdeeds!"

1511.speaker: Narrator
1511.text: He made a face as if he'd just smelled something awful.

1512.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1512.text: "In Golcondism, intimacy between men is seen as the most sacred form of love. They say it strengthens bonds on the battlefield."

1513.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1513.text: "In Derdia, not only is this perversion legalized, it is condoned. In stark defiance of the writings of both St. Dast and St. Wruhec."

1514.speaker: Player_Romus
1514.text: "A whole country full of muscular warriors making love to one another. I shudder to think of such a thing."

1518.speaker: Player_Romus
1518.text: "What about female homosexuality? Do they allow two women to be together?"

1519.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1519.text: "As long as women accept their role as providers and childbearers, they may consort among themselves if they wish."

1520.speaker: Player_Romus
1520.text: "So you're saying that lifting Rizia's homosexuality ban will help normalize relations with Derdia."

1521.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1521.text: "It is a most regressive society, Your Majesty. Not at all like ours."

1522.speaker: Player_Romus
1522.text: "I don't understand why our saints condemned homosexuality in the first place. Love is love, after all."

1523.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1523.text: "Perhaps, Your Majesty, but at what cost? Such a societal change would shake the very bedrock upon which Rizia is founded."

1524.speaker: Player_Romus
1524.text: "How terrible. Have they no respect for the laws of God and nature?"

1528.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1528.text: "The so-called 'love' that the Derdians espouse is nothing but an obscene mockery of the sacred bond between a man and a woman."

1533.speaker: Player_Romus
1533.text: "If my father truly cared about this, he would have brought it up with me."

1534.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1534.text: "He was going to, Your Majesty. He told me as much, before..."

1535.speaker: Narrator
1535.text: His voice caught in his throat. He didn't continue.

1536.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1536.text: "Indeed it could. For better, or for worse."

1537.speaker: Narrator
1537.text: He reached into his pocket and pulled out a creased sheet of paper.

1538.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1538.text: "As a member of your Council, I don't have many chances to commune with the Wruhecist public."

1539.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1539.text: "But a former student of mine, Sevrio Castellanus, has been rising in influence among the faithful. He sent me a message to pass on to you."

1540.speaker: Narrator
1540.text: He consulted the letter in his hand and smiled.

1541.speaker: Narrator
1541.text: He stared at the letter, as if willing its contents to change.

1542.speaker: Narrator
1542.text: He consulted the letter in his hand with a thoughtful expression.

1547.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1547.text: "With little help coming from the government, the onus is on the Sanctuary to aid those most in need."

1548.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1548.text: "If the current situation continues, I am afraid it may lead to mass discontent."

1549.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1549.text: "Especially if more is not done to please the kingdom's Wruhecist faithful."

1550.speaker: Player_Romus
1550.text: "This is the first I've heard of this Sevrio fellow. Why should I trust what he has to say?"

1551.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1551.text: "I foresee a time when he could be very useful to the Crown. But only if more is done to please his followers."

1552.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1552.text: "He has been visiting sanctuaries across the kingdom, preaching our faith and listening to the people."

1553.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1553.text: "Keep his followers happy, and I foresee a time when they will be very useful to the Crown."

1557.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1557.text: "The Lord does not intervene directly. He grants us the wisdom to provide for our most vulnerable."

1558.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1558.text: "True, but the Sanctuary's support has its limits. Volunteers are stretched thin compared to the government's capacity."

1562.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1562.text: "I understand, Your Majesty, but poverty often traps individuals in a cycle that's difficult to break."

1563.speaker: Player_Romus
1563.text: "I see. Perhaps increased collaboration between the Crown and the Sanctuary could help make a difference in these vulnerable citizens' lives."

1564.speaker: Player_Romus
1564.text: "If these subjects are truly worthy, the Lord will provide for them."

1565.speaker: Player_Romus
1565.text: "I don't want dependence on handouts from the Crown or the Sanctuary. People must pull themselves up by their own bootstraps."

1566.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1566.text: "I feel the same way, Your Majesty."

1567.speaker: Player_Romus
1567.text: "I don't see a problem with that. Charity is a Wruhecist principle, is it not?"

1569.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1569.text: "He speaks of pain, Your Majesty. His congregants complain of worsening living standards, to the extent that some can no longer feed or house their families."

1573.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1573.text: "And so I urge you to continue your efforts to please the kingdom's Wruhecist faithful."

1574.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1574.text: "As for the Dastnurist Archpriests with whom I have conversed..."

1578.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1578.text: "As we celebrate this event, I’d be honored to retell the story, if you'd like."

1579.speaker: Player_Romus
1579.text: "I'm actually not all that familiar with it. Please, by all means."

1581.speaker: Sal Ignacius
1581.text: "Even the most righteous intentions can cast a shadow."

1582.speaker: Narrator
1582.text: Sal paused, as though deep in thought.

1583.speaker: Narrator
1583.text: Sal took a measured step forward, his gaze flickering with both resolve and caution.

1584.speaker: Narrator
1584.text: A distant bell tolled in the city below as Sal folded his hands behind his back, waiting for me to continue.

1585.speaker: Narrator
1585.text: A faint breeze stirred Sal’s robes as though he were considering where to begin.

1586.speaker: Narrator
1586.text: I looked once more up to the sky, but the clouds still obscured any trace of the Alignment.
